name: Lai Fen Yexiao ma?
source:
It's late at night. The street is cold and quiet. You're hungry.

Lucky, there is café nearby opening at night.

.........

However, there are two catches: 

(1) The shop owner is a little bit noisy and irritating rabbit and he needs some ingredients to earn money.

(2) Your meat is his ingredients.

[Translated from [url=https://frozen-iris.itch.io/a-late-night-snack]Itch.io[/url]]
